items.title: Iron Pointe
items.text: Homes next to the golf club with covered patios.

items.title: Boulder Hills Estates
items.text: An established community near the same corridor. New or a few years in, we bring film and blinds to your door.

v3.how_fear: Tell us your closing or walkthrough date and the rooms you want done. The measure and the quote are free, and nothing is booked until we confirm a time with you.

items.question: When is the best time to tint a new home?
items.answer: As soon as you take possession, ideally before you move in. An empty home is the fastest, cleanest install.

items.question: Can you finish film and blinds before move-in?
items.answer: Yes. Coordinate with us around your closing or walkthrough date and we can plan film and blinds before the moving truck arrives. Blinds are ordered to your measurements, so there is a wait between the measure and the install.

items.question: Do you serve Liberty Ridge, Iron Pointe and Boulder Hills Estates?
items.answer: Yes. Our shop is in Boulder City and we cover all of Boulder City, Henderson and Southern Nevada.

items.question: Can you do the new car in the driveway too?
items.answer: Yes. Car tint, ceramic coating and clear bra are done at the shop.
